text: While Brown sat applauding himself. <break time="0.8s" /> He heard horses on the road. <break time="0.8s" /> And recognized the voices. <break time="0.8s" /> Of the minister and Deacon Gookin. <break time="0.8s" /> Who were also hurrying. <break time="0.8s" /> Toward the meeting. <break time="0.8s" /> There is a goodly young woman. <break time="0.8s" /> To be taken into communion. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the deacon. <break time="0.8s" /> And Brown. <break time="0.8s" /> Catching hold of a tree for support. <break time="0.8s" /> Nearly sank to the ground. <break time="0.8s" /> With heaven above and Faith below. <break time="0.8s" /> I will yet stand firm. <break time="0.8s" /> Against the devil, cried Brown. <break time="0.8s" /> But a black mass of cloud. <break time="0.8s" /> Was already sweeping across the sky. <break time="0.8s" /> And hiding the stars. <break time="0.8s" /> From the cloud came. <break time="0.8s" /> A confused murmur of voices. <break time="0.8s" /> Among which Brown seemed to hear. <break time="0.8s" /> The voices of pious townspeople. <break time="0.8s" /> And, at last. <break time="0.8s" /> The sad voice of a young woman. <break time="0.8s" /> Faith, shouted Goodman Brown. <break time="0.8s" /> In a voice of agony and despair. <break time="0.8s" /> And the echoes of the forest mocked him. <break time="0.8s" /> Crying Faith, Faith. <break time="0.8s" /> As if bewildered wretches. <break time="0.8s" /> Were seeking her through the wilderness. <break time="0.8s" /> Then something fluttered lightly down. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the air. <break time="0.8s" /> And caught on the branch of a tree. <break time="0.8s" /> And the young man seized it. <break time="0.8s" /> And beheld a pink ribbon. <break time="0.8s" /> My Faith is gone, cried he. <break time="0.8s" /> There is no good on earth. <break time="0.8s" /> And sin is but a name. <break time="0.8s" /> And to thee, devil. <break time="0.8s" /> Is this world given. <break time="0.8s" /> Maddened with despair. <break time="0.8s" /> Brown grasped his staff. <break time="0.8s" /> And rushed along the forest path. <break time="0.8s" /> Laughing loudly. <break time="0.8s" /> Until he became himself. <break time="0.8s" /> The most frightful figure. <break time="0.8s" /> In that dark wilderness. <break time="0.8s" /> At last he came to an open space. <break time="0.8s" /> Where a rock like an altar stood. <break time="0.8s" /> Among four blazing pines. <break time="0.8s" /> And a numerous congregation of townspeople. <break time="0.8s" /> Had gathered in the red light.
